name: Moodle
description_en:
Moodle is a family of learning products built around Moodle LMS, an open-source course-management platform. Moodle Workplace, MoodleCloud, the mobile app and partner services have different roles and commercial conditions.

Free access to Moodle LMS source code does not provide free hosting or the same capabilities as every hosted plan. The deployment choice determines who maintains the learning environment.
description_zh:
Moodle 是围绕开源 Moodle LMS 的学习产品家族，Moodle Workplace、MoodleCloud、移动应用及合作伙伴服务各有职责及商业条件。

免费取得 Moodle LMS 源码不等于免费托管，也不等于拥有所有托管套餐功能。部署选择决定谁来维护学习环境。

core_features.explanation_en: The core LMS can be downloaded and customized under its open-source terms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 核心 LMS 可按开源条款下载及定制。

core_features.explanation_en: MoodleCloud simplifies operation but disallows installing your own plugins.
core_features.explanation_zh: MoodleCloud 简化运营，但不允许自行安装插件。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The official site positions Moodle LMS for flexible course delivery and customization, Workplace for organizational training and compliance, and MoodleCloud for smaller-scale hosted needs. The open-source page explicitly allows downloading and customizing LMS software. That statement should not be extended automatically to every Workplace feature, service contract or paid plugin.
sections.zh: 官网将 Moodle LMS 定位为灵活课程交付及定制，Workplace 用于组织培训和合规，MoodleCloud 面向较小规模托管。开源页明确介绍免费下载及定制 LMS 软件，但不能自动推广到所有 Workplace 功能、服务合同或付费插件。

sections.title_en: Example: a course with an assignment and feedback
sections.title_zh: 示例：包含作业和反馈的课程
sections.en: Build a small course, enroll a teacher and learner, publish a resource and assignment, and verify submission, feedback and completion evidence. Test a second attempt and a learner resuming unfinished work. In a self-hosted environment also rehearse restoring the site and files before depending on them. This is a proposed pilot, not an installation or backup test performed here.
sections.zh: 搭建小课程，登记教师和学员，发布资源与作业，再验证提交、反馈和完成证据。检查第二次提交及恢复未完成学习。自托管还应在正式依赖前演练站点和文件恢复。本例是建议试点，本文未执行安装或备份测试。

sections.title_en: Hosted convenience has explicit customization limits
sections.title_zh: 托管便利伴随明确的定制限制
sections.en: The MoodleCloud page offers a starter trial and links to plan purchasing; no complete base-price matrix was retrieved on this page. Its FAQ says MoodleCloud does not allow installing your own plugins. Custom domains are available on Medium and Standard, included on Standard but listed as an additional AUD160/year on Medium, with possible taxes. Larger customized Moodle solutions are quoted through partners. Leave a universal monthly starting price unset rather than mixing these products.
sections.zh: MoodleCloud 页提供入门试用并链接套餐购买，本页未读取完整基础价格表。FAQ 明确 MoodleCloud 不允许自行安装插件；Medium 和 Standard 可用自有域名，Standard 包含，Medium 则列每年另收 160 澳元，可能另有税费。更大或需定制的 Moodle 方案通过合作伙伴报价。不能混合这些产品生成一个通用月起价。

sections.title_zh: 扩展前先确定运维责任
sections.en: For self-hosting, assign an owner for infrastructure, upgrades, plugins, backups and access control. For hosted procurement, list required integrations before selecting a plan whose restrictions may prevent them. Moodle suits organizations prepared to configure learning workflows; installing software does not create effective content or accredited outcomes. Exact license-version obligations for a chosen distribution, plugin terms, migration fidelity and recovery remain to be checked.
sections.zh: 自托管应安排基础设施、升级、插件、备份和访问控制负责人；托管采购则需先列集成要求，避免选到禁止所需扩展的套餐。它适合愿意配置学习流程的组织，安装软件不等于产生有效内容或受认可学习成果。具体发行版许可义务、插件条款、迁移完整性及恢复仍需核查。
